plain.li: [ward,warm,askward,theirHightech] Yes, and gladly. Our youth has a bag packed and a list of questions longer than the bag.
[ward,warm,askward,letter] Your letter was read to the whole family, and the youth we chose hasn't sat still since. They will come.
[ward,cordial,askward,theirLowtech] A youth of our house will come. Teach them well and feed them well, as we would one of yours.
[ward,cool,askward,theirHightech] We'll send someone. We expect them back as well as they left.
[ward,cool,askward,call] All right, {WRITER}. One of ours will come. Don't make us regret it.
[ward,refusal,askward,theirHightech] We've asked, and no family here wants to send a youth away for a year. I'm sorry.
[ward,refusal,askward,letter] We read your letter at our table and argued about it until late. The answer is no, this year.
[ward,warm,send,theirLowtech] Send your youth to us. They will eat at our table and work beside our own.
[ward,warm,send,call] Of course, {WRITER}. We'll have a bed made up before they arrive.
[ward,cordial,send] We'll take them, and we'll keep them busy. They'll come home knowing more than they left with.
[ward,cool,send,theirHightech] Approved, on the usual terms. They will be expected to work.
[ward,refusal,send,theirLowtech] We have too many mouths this year to take in another. Ask again in a better one.
[ward,refusal,send,theirHightech] We can't take on another youth at present. Our apologies to them.
[ward,warm,send,page] The household is pleased to accept your youth as a page. They will be taught to serve at table and to hold their tongue.
[ward,cool,send,page] A page from your colony may come. The household expects them to learn its ways quickly.
[ward,refusal,send,page,call] The household has no place for a page this year, {WRITER}. Do not take it personally.
[greetings,cordial,tie:ward:theirs,theirLowtech] We think of {WARD} at every meal, and it is strange to set no place for them.
[greetings,warm,tie:ward:theirs,theirHightech] Thank you for keeping {WARD}. Their room here is just as they left it.
[news,cordial,tie:ward:theirs] Here is our news. Pass it on to {WARD}, who will want to hear it.
[condolences,warm,tie:ward:theirs] Your loss is felt here too. Tell {WARD} we are thinking of them as well.
[warning,cordial,tie:ward:theirs] Thank you for the warning. Keep {WARD} close until it passes, as we know you will.
[help,cordial,tie:ward:theirs] Since you keep {WARD} for us, we can spare something for you.
[greetings,cool,tie:ward:ours] {WARD} is well enough. They ask about home more often than they ask about their work.
[greetings,cordial,tie:ward:ours,theirHightech] {WARD} has settled in, and has already rearranged half the workshop.
[condolences,warm,tie:ward:ours] {WARD} wept when your letter came. We sat with them until late.
[help,warm,tie:ward:ours] {WARD} heard you needed help and asked us to send it. We would have anyway.
[invitation,warm,tie:ward:ours] We would come gladly. {WARD} asked to come along, but their year with us isn't out.
[greetings,cordial,tie:hostage:theirs,theirLowtech,!tie:hostage:due] {HOSTAGE} stands for our word among you. Treat them as we treat the word.
[greetings,warm,tie:hostage:theirs,!tie:hostage:due] Thank you for your letter. Tell {HOSTAGE} their family is well.
[news,cordial,tie:hostage:theirs,!tie:hostage:due] Here is our news. {HOSTAGE} will want to hear it, so read it to them.
[greetings,cool,tie:hostage:ours,theirHightech,!tie:hostage:due] {HOSTAGE} is kept as agreed. We see no reason to say more.
[greetings,warm,tie:hostage:ours,!tie:hostage:due] {HOSTAGE} has become good company here. We'll be sorry when the term is out.
[help,cordial,tie:hostage:ours,!tie:hostage:due] We hold {HOSTAGE} for your word, and your word has been good. Here is help, freely given.
[greetings,curt,tie:hostage:due,tie:hostage:ours,theirLowtech] {HOSTAGE} sleeps under guard now, because of what your colony did.
[help,refusal,tie:hostage:due,tie:hostage:ours] You broke your word, and we hold {HOSTAGE}. Do not ask us for anything else.
[greetings,cool,tie:hostage:due,tie:hostage:theirs,theirLowtech] We know what our side did, and we know {HOSTAGE} pays for it. Be fair with them.
[wardlesson,us] Again, and this time don't rush it.
[wardlesson,us] Good, now tell me why that worked.
[wardlesson,us,kind] Take your time, there's no hurry with this one.
[wardlesson,us,abrasive] Watch closely, I'm not showing you a third time.
[wardlesson,us,old] My teacher showed me this the same way, and I made the same mistakes.
[wardlearn,them] What happens if I get it wrong?
[wardlearn,them,child] Can I show you what I did yesterday?
[wardlearn,them,teen] I think I've got it now, watch.
[wardlearn,them,theirLowtech] At home my uncle does it the other way round.
[wardmeet,them] I'll try not to be too much trouble.
[wardmeet,them,theirLowtech] My family sends their respects, and me with them.
[wardbye,them] One day I'll come back and show you how much I remember.
[wardbye,them,child] Will you miss me?
[wardbye,them,kind] I'll miss the lessons, and you most of all.
[wardkin,them] There you are, let's have a look at you.
[wardkin,them] Say your goodbyes, we've a long road home.
[wardkin,them,theirHightech] Pick up your things, the road won't wait for us.
[hostagego,us] Tell them at home I went willingly.
[hostagego,us] It's only a term, and terms end.
[hostagego,us,lowtech] Let it be said I went for the colony's word.
[hostagego,us,abrasive] Fine, but somebody had better keep the terms.
[hostagego,us,lowmood] Well, at least it'll be quiet there.
